egress.terms: TRAP-SHAPED but escapable. Verbatim from support: 'Every pCloud plan includes a specified amount of shared link traffic that resets on a monthly basis (regardless of whether you have a monthly, annual, or Lifetime subscription) .. pCloud Premium Plus (2 TB): 4 TB per month .. pCloud Ultra (10 TB): 20 TB per month'. Blog confirms the ratio is 2x storage: 'As of September, 2026, it is double the amount of your paid storage'. CRITICAL EXEMPTION: this cap applies only to public shared links. API, WebDAV and app downloads are not counted, per pCloud's own link-traffic explainer.

record.interface_detail: REST API (api.pcloud.com, probed live: getapiserver returns result 0 with binapi/api hosts), WebDAV, rsync, rclone native `pcloud` backend, FUSE-style virtual drive
record.tooling: rclone native; WebDAV+rsync documented by vendor
record.chaining: rclone/WebDAV -> local -> CDN; virtual drive mount is a genuine advantage vs sync-only competitors
record.limits_note: Constraint type: per-object none; egress is pull-count-ish only on public links. Folder share caps: 150 folder shares/day, 25,000 subfolders or 150,000 files per shared folder.

identity_cost.detail: the account is created with an email address and a verification link, and the vendor's account guidance names an email address and a password; whether registration asks a phone number is unverified. The lifetime plan is bought with a credit or debit card, with PayPal backed by a linked credit or debit card, or with Alipay in select regions

record.reliability_note: Operates since 2013, Swiss entity. No mass data-loss event. r/DataHoarder 'The Lifetime Trap' thread documents $745 spent and ROI scepticism, not data loss. Payment: card, PayPal, Alipay for select regions; Bitcoin historically accepted (Apple/Google in-app also available).

egress.terms: Same as pCloud paid. Unrestricted transfer speeds, no per-GB meter.

record.tooling: Rclone backend `pcloud`. The trial grant is a normal quota bump, so rclone works unchanged against it.
record.chaining: The grant repeats: a new email address creates a new account that holds a new 500 GB for 3 months. 4 grant cycles a year x N email addresses. 10 email addresses = 5 TB of rolling free capacity. The friction is re-uploading data each cycle and that rclone remotes must be re-authed per account.
record.limits_note: 3-month expiry hard-stop; capacity reverts to 10 GB (data above the free cap becomes read-only or is reclaimed). No card, so no auto-charge risk. Promo codes rotate seasonally. This one is a 'Photography Day' code live since at least 2026-08-13.
record.reliability_note: Highest-confidence repeatable trial found. It is a marketing code, not a security hole, so it is unlikely to be retroactively enforced; but pCloud can invalidate a code at any time. Verified the promo-redemption page is live; did not burn an account to confirm the grant lands.
